properties.decision: Options, from the 2026-10-19 root cause: (a) SMALL, keeps ruling #3b: the refusal says the type is asked for on purpose as a confirmation, and names what the id holds ("req:one is a Requirement with N edges; pass node_type: \"Requirement\" to delete it"). (b) MEDIUM, reopens #3b: node_type optional; when omitted, delete only if the holder's type is the one the id's prefix names by convention (req: → Requirement), refuse otherwise or on collision — the prefix becomes the caller's stated belief. (c) SMALL, reopens #3b: optional and resolved exactly like every other tool. (d) LARGER: an omitted type returns a preview (the node, its edge count, what loses a link) and a confirm step.
properties.name: OPEN — field limitation 23: keep delete_node's required type and say why (naming the type the id resolves to), or let the id's prefix stand as the caller's stated type?
properties.rationale: The strict form was Anthony's ruling (2026-09-06) and is pinned by a test, so it is not a defect; the field met it with no reason given. Counter-argument to (b)/(c): delete is the one irreversible call, and a ruling stands until he reopens it. Counter-argument to (a): an agent copies the type the refusal names, so (a) adds a round trip and almost no check; (b) keeps a real check (prefix vs holder) without the round trip.
